facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple bell struck nine Aurèle had everyone show watches, and that the speaker's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Transcript states piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by the speaker's watch, going out to the hall for the cigar case in the coat, Madame starting the piano as he left and stopping when he returned.
Transcript states that when the temple struck ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and the speaker remarked on it to Madame.
